character.appendages: No legs, feet, hands, skeletal arms, wings or separate tail. Crest, lateral wisps and lower taper remain attached to the same continuous vapor body.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas is 64x64 with source origin [28,38]. Upright poses hover or taper near the origin; flat poses extend laterally but retain donor-local placement. Main/Sub canonical reuse and translations remain authoritative.
character.faceAndExpression: One central facial aperture changes from a small slit to a large red opening, shifts with turns, compresses near the base and becomes fully occluded in rear or collapsed cells. It must not be pasted identically across poses.
character.locomotion: The whole vapor body hovers, settles, stretches vertically, flares sideways, bends diagonally, sweeps horizontally and collapses flat. Preserve raw sequence IDs and do not invent action labels.
character.morphology: Tiny hovering vapor larva made from one continuous tapering wisp body with one attached top plume and soft side wisps. The side wisps are deformations of the same vapor mass, not arms or wings.
character.restraint: Main cells 026-042 form the restrained block, including aliases. A gold-brown binding crosses the lower-central body and follows compact, tall, flared and horizontal postures while leaving the facial aperture readable when the donor does.
character.specialStates: Cells 043/044/045 are orange-red or black special states, 058 is stone-gray and 061 is the white evolution silhouette. Derive them deterministically from accepted original poses whenever alpha equivalence proves the contour.
